items.distractor_fact: Termometern i grannbyn visade {D} grader Celsius samma morgon.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring village showed {D} degrees Celsius the same morning.
items.entity_note: A different village's thermometer, not the one at the story's location.

items.distractor_fact: Ett annat bolags aktie kostade {D} kronor samma dag.
items.gloss_en: Another company's stock cost {D} kronor the same day.
items.entity_note: A different company's stock, not the one being tracked.

items.distractor_fact: Vattenytan i den närliggande sjön låg på {D} meter över sitt eget bottenmärke.
items.gloss_en: The water surface in the nearby lake stood at {D} meters above its own base mark.
items.entity_note: A different body of water, measured against its own separate base mark.

items.distractor_fact: En annan klättares höjdmätare visade {D} meter över havet vid samma tillfälle.
items.gloss_en: Another climber's altimeter showed {D} meters above sea level at the same moment.
items.entity_note: A different climber's instrument, not the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: En annan patient på avdelningen vägde {D} kilogram.
items.gloss_en: Another patient on the ward weighed {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: A different patient, not the one being treated.

items.distractor_fact: Grannbyn hade {D} invånare vid samma folkräkning.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring village had {D} inhabitants at the same census.

items.distractor_fact: En annan bils hastighetsmätare visade {D} kilometer i timmen vid samma kurva.
items.gloss_en: Another car's speedometer showed {D} kilometers per hour at the same curve.

items.distractor_fact: På ett annat konto sattes {D} kronor in under samma månad.
items.gloss_en: Into another account, {D} kronor were deposited during the same month.
items.entity_note: A different bank account, not the account holder's own.

items.distractor_fact: Ett annat företag i branschen hade en kostnad på {D} kronor under kvartalet.
items.gloss_en: Another company in the industry had a cost of {D} kronor during the quarter.

items.distractor_fact: Ett annat lag i ligan gjorde {D} mål under säsongen.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the league scored {D} goals during the season.

items.distractor_fact: En annan investerare hade en vinst på {D} kronor under året.
items.gloss_en: Another investor had a gain of {D} kronor during the year.

items.distractor_fact: Ett annat fabriksverk i koncernen tillverkade {D} enheter under samma vecka, mätt mot sitt eget separata mål.
items.gloss_en: Another factory plant in the group manufactured {D} units during the same week, measured against its own separate target.
items.entity_note: A different factory with its own unstated target, so the story's stated target does not apply to it.

items.distractor_fact: En annan golfspelare på en annan bana slog {D} slag på sitt hål.
items.gloss_en: Another golfer on a different course played {D} strokes on their hole.
items.entity_note: A different golfer on a different course, whose hole's par is never stated.

items.distractor_fact: En annan tåglinje hade ett tåg som anlände klockan som motsvarar {D} minuter efter midnatt, enligt sin egen tidtabell.
items.gloss_en: Another train line had a train that arrived at the minute mark corresponding to {D} minutes after midnight, according to its own timetable.
items.entity_note: A different train line with its own separate timetable, not the schedule stated in the story.
